description_en: Modifies the configuration items of an automatic snapshot policy, including the policy name and snapshot retention period
description_zh: 修改自动快照策略的配置项，包括策略名称、快照保留时间等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id sp-itcmrhqt01tdo0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。默认值：空
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The retention period of automatic snapshots. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 180
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：1\~180
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: The type of cloud disk for which the automatic snapshot policy creates snapshots
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略要创建的快照的磁盘类型
parameters.name: disk_type
